captions: Burned into video; separate SRT included.
recording: One fresh live public-site investigation started through the real form. Continuous screen capture at normal time, no replay substitution, no favorable reroll.
credential_handling: Entered from ignored local environment directly into password input; no plaintext key recorded or written into artifacts.

result.limitations: Structured propositions and authored alternative proof paths are scored. Narrative is unscored; this is not a general natural-language fact checker.

chapters.caption:
How to start an investigation in Mercy House
A fresh live API run, from setup to final report. Captions only; voice mode is off.

1. Click New investigation. Choose a case.
Start with The Lantern Room for an introductory investigation.

2. Read the case briefing before starting.
It describes your assignment; evidence and witness accounts must be discovered during the case.

3. Choose your provider, model ID and case seed.
This demonstration uses the organizer’s configured endpoint. Other providers are available in the selector.

4. Enter your provider API key in the masked field.
On the public demo, your key powers both the detective and the town’s character agents for this run.

5. Click Begin live investigation.
The system prepares isolated containers and checks that the selected case has a valid reference solution.

The live investigation is starting.
Container preparation and model response times are shown as they happen; this is not a prerecorded replay.

The detective is searching the current location.
Newly acquired material appears in the evidence tray on the right.

The detective is interviewing a character.
Questions, answers and any shown documents appear as the model investigates.

The detective is collecting a discovered item.
Evidence must be acquired through the world tools before it can support a report.

The detective is travelling to another location.
The background and people present follow the actual world state.

The investigation has ended.
We will inspect the actual submitted report and verifier outcome, including any unsupported findings.

6. Read the final report and verifier result.
This run scored 1.00. Supported, false and unsupported findings are listed separately. Guessing a name alone earns no proof.

Click a cited source to inspect the evidence behind a conclusion.
The viewer exposes acquired public records; private world files and unreleased character memories stay hidden.

The interview notebook preserves the questions and answers already observed.
Use it to review follow-ups and documents shown during questioning.

Start your own investigation at mercyhouse.abhi07.xyz
New investigation → case → provider and model → masked API key → Begin. Recorded cases remain free to watch.
